title: imagebuildah: regression tests for waitForStage semaphore balance; nil-safe content summary
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

`waitForStage` gives up the stage goroutine's job-semaphore token while it polls another stage, then tries to take it back. Before 57fded636 ("Add context-aware versions of several functions and some methods") it reacquired with the build context, so when a remote `podman build` client dropped, `Acquire` returned immediately without a token, the goroutine's `defer Release(1)` fired, and `golang.org/x/sync/semaphore` panicked:

    panic: semaphore: released more than held

Inside `podman system service` that panic kills the whole API server; other in-flight remote builds on the same socket die with `server probably quit: unexpected EOF`.

Main now reacquires with `context.Background()` (57fded636), so the semaphore change from the first revision of this PR is gone after rebase. What remains:

- Unit tests that pin the "caller still holds the token" invariant on the cancelled-context and already-terminated paths, so the fix cannot regress silently. The cancelled-context test fails on any tree that reacquires with the build context.
- An empty content summary when the stage's builder is already gone, which nil-derefs on the same cancel path (`getContentSummaryAfterAddingContent`).

#### How to verify it

```
go test -tags 'exclude_graphdriver_btrfs exclude_graphdriver_devicemapper containers_image_openpgp' ./imagebuildah \
  -run 'TestWaitForStageCancelledContextDoesNotOverRelease|TestWaitForStageAlreadyTerminatedKeepsToken|TestGetContentSummaryAfterAddingContentNilBuilder'
```

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #7091

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

I hit this on Homebrew podman 6.1.1 (vendored buildah 1.45.0) serving several GitHub Actions slots through one user-scope API socket. Cancelling one build panicked the server and took down the others.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
Fix a nil-pointer panic in the content-summary path when a remote build is cancelled while waiting on another stage; add regression tests for the job-semaphore balance fixed in 57fded636.
```

comments.body:
#7007 tweaks that part of the logic to use context.Background() when acquiring the semaphore so that it won't error out if the context was canceled - this error triggers more often in testing when the cancellation logic is properly wired up.
The new tests being added here in executor_test.go pass with its changes, and I'm not sure that it can still hit the case where the new guard in stage_executor.go would be necessary.
@AtwoodTM looks like a rebase might be required here.

Rebased on main. 57fded636 already switched the reacquire to `context.Background()`, so the semaphore change dropped out in the rebase; what is left is the regression tests for that invariant plus the nil-builder guard in `getContentSummaryAfterAddingContent`. Title and description updated to match.
